subtitle: Learn the harmonic and melodic principles behind memorable pop guitar riffs

columns.title: Accessibility First
columns.text: Pop riffs prioritize memorability and emotional connection over technical complexity. Understanding why certain patterns stick in our minds is key to creating effective pop guitar parts.

columns.title: Harmonic Foundation
columns.text: Pop music relies on proven harmonic formulas that create emotional responses. Learning these patterns gives you the tools to craft compelling musical hooks.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: This progression appears in countless pop songs because it provides strong harmonic movement while remaining accessible. Each chord has a specific emotional function.

cards.title: Hook Construction Principles

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Pop hooks use specific melodic and rhythmic patterns that maximize memorability through repetition, sequence, and motivic development.

items: Motivic repetition - same pattern at different pitch levels
Sequence - melodic pattern repeated at different scale degrees
Rhythmic consistency - predictable note placement aids memory

cards.title: Modal Borrowing in Pop

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Pop music frequently borrows chords from parallel modes to add color while maintaining accessibility.

items: bVII chord (from mixolydian) - adds rock flavor
bVI chord (from natural minor) - creates emotional depth
ii° chord (from natural minor) - adds sophistication

steps.title: Basic Progressions

steps.title: Advanced Harmony
steps.description: Incorporate modal borrowing, extended chords, and sophisticated voice leading while maintaining pop accessibility.
